schema:
CREATE TABLE "Sessions" ("session_id" INTEGER, "member_id" INTEGER, UNIQUE ("session_id"));

CREATE TABLE "Purchases" ("purchase_id" INTEGER, "session_id" INTEGER, "total_cost" INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY ("session_id") REFERENCES "Sessions" ("session_id"), UNIQUE ("purchase_id"));
correct_query: SELECT member_id, COUNT(*) AS empty_session_cnt FROM Sessions WHERE NOT session_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT session_id FROM Purchases) GROUP BY member_id

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Adds a spurious WHERE total_cost > 0 filter inside the NOT IN subquery, failing to exclude sessions whose purchases have total_cost <= 0.
